Commercial & Operational Due Diligence

Commercial & Operational Due Diligence

The operational read your financial diligence can't give you. We complement Big Four financial DD; we don't replace it. Where they read the numbers, we read the asset like operators.

What we examine

Four lenses on the asset

Commercial

  • Revenue quality
  • Customer concentration
  • Contract portfolio
  • Pricing power
  • Demand drivers

Operational

  • Utilization
  • Maintenance and drydock
  • HSE and compliance
  • Crewing
  • Technical management

Fleet and asset

  • Condition
  • Class status
  • Valuation cross-check
  • Capex obligations

Organization

  • Key-person risk
  • Management depth
  • Succession
What you get

Deliverables

  • A 15 to 25 page report.
  • A one-page red-flag summary for the IC.
  • A 100-day value-creation lever list.
  • An IC debrief call.
How we work

Our process

Scoping, then data request and desk analysis, management interviews, site and asset review, synthesis, and a report with a debrief. Two to four weeks from data access.

Why us

Operators, not bankers

We are operators, not bankers. We complement Big Four financial DD with the operational depth they lack, at a fraction of bulge-bracket cost.

Track record reflects the founding team's operator experience prior to Navex. Across a 25-year operating career: five exits, more than ten bolt-on acquisitions, and over $1bn in enterprise value shaped.
